title: Long-term follow-up study to AU-011-301 study
official: A Long-Term Follow-Up Study of Subjects Completing the AU-011-301 (CoMpass) Trial of Bel-sar for Early Choroidal Melanoma (Indeterminate Lesions/Small Choroidal Melanomas)
summary:
Main objective: 1. To determine the long-term safety of bel-sar for the treatment early CM in the AU-011-301 trial.
		
2. To determine the long-term efficacy of bel-sar for the treatment of early CM in the AU-011-301 trial.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Have received bel-sar or sham treatment in the Aura-sponsored clinical trial AU-011-301.
2. 2. Be willing and able to consent to the AU-011-403 study.
Exclusion criteria:
1. None
